features.raw_data: Packet timestamps and packet counts of each flow (CICFlowMeter).
features.calculation: (Tot Fwd Pkts + Tot Bwd Pkts) / Flow Duration, in packets per second.
features.assumption: A flood sends packets at a higher rate than normal flows.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Video streaming, large downloads, backups, bursts after a popular page goes live.
features.evasion: Spread the attack over many more bots or connections so each flow has a normal rate.

features.raw_data: Packet sizes and timestamps of each flow.
features.calculation: (TotLen Fwd Pkts + TotLen Bwd Pkts) / Flow Duration, in bytes per second.
features.assumption: A flood moves more bytes per second than a normal flow.
features.evasion: Use small packets or a lower per-flow rate across many sources.

features.raw_data: Timestamps of the first and last packet of each flow.
features.calculation: Time between the first and last packet of the flow, in microseconds.
features.assumption: Attack tools open many short connections, so attack flows are shorter.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Short DNS lookups, health checks, single small HTTP requests.
features.evasion: Hold connections open longer (slow, long-lived requests) or reuse connections.

features.raw_data: Packet counts in each direction (Tot Fwd Pkts, Tot Bwd Pkts).
features.calculation: Tot Fwd Pkts / (Tot Bwd Pkts + 1). The +1 avoids dividing by zero for one-way flows.
features.assumption: Flood traffic is mostly one-way: the attacker sends much more than the victim answers.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Uploads, one-way UDP streams, telemetry and logging traffic.
features.evasion: Use requests that make the server reply (complete handshakes, request large responses).

features.raw_data: Timestamps of every packet in the flow.
features.calculation: Mean time between consecutive packets of the flow, in microseconds.
features.assumption: Automated tools send packets back-to-back, so the mean gap is smaller.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Bulk transfers and streaming also send packets back-to-back.

features.raw_data: Timestamps of every packet in the flow.
features.calculation: Standard deviation of the time between consecutive packets, in microseconds.
features.assumption: Tool traffic is machine-regular, so the gaps vary less than in human-driven traffic.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Periodic keep-alives, polling clients, monitoring agents.
features.evasion: Add random jitter to the packet timing.

features.raw_data: TCP flags of every packet in the flow.
features.calculation: Number of packets in the flow with the SYN flag set.
features.assumption: SYN-based floods set the SYN flag on many packets.
features.legitimate_lookalike: Connection retries on a lossy network, legitimate port scanners.
features.evasion: Use application-layer floods (HTTP) over fully opened connections, or UDP.

features.raw_data: Sizes of the packets sent from source to destination.
features.calculation: Mean size of forward packets in the flow, in bytes.
features.assumption: Flood packets are small (little or no payload).
features.legitimate_lookalike: ACK-only traffic, small API calls, IoT messages.

features.raw_data: Sizes of the packets sent from source to destination.
features.calculation: Standard deviation of forward packet sizes in the flow, in bytes.
features.assumption: A tool sends identical packets, so the sizes hardly vary.
